content: Frozen benchmark aggregates and de-identified group-waveform summaries only; no source archive, run/sample/patient identifier, individual trace or prediction-level row is included.
interpretation_limits: Sequencing outcome models use same-run context and during/post-run diagnostics, not future-run forecasting.
The separate six-instrument earlier-CSA forecasting study did not establish reliable added forecasting value over outcome history; its cohort differs from the expanded diagnostic study.
QPM classification and regression targets are programmed command volumes, not independently measured delivered liquid volumes.
MAE has physical units and cannot be converted to accuracy using 1-MAE.
RawTrace rendered-image descriptors are not calibrated amplitude/SNR or specific evidence of a nucleotide/salt fault.
Count/geometry proxies at ranks 3, 4 and 9 are withheld as loading or chip-health measurements.
Held-out permutation importance is predictive dependence, not causal impact or reads lost.
Saved outer-fold feature-importance intervals are exploratory, not physical-run confidence intervals.
The observed barcode example exports only group medians/IQR and counts; its AUC values are saved within-run post-hoc score separation, not held-out diagnostic sensitivity or causal proof.
Reference qualification is an eligibility rule, not independent proof that a source run was fault-free.
